changes.story: Paint thinner dumped repeatedly has turned the Ilm sickly yellow-green and killed fish.

entry.headline: Weimar survives divided: solar and gardens versus pollution, trash, and a dying river.
entry.outlook: Weimar is a town of two minds: solar panels and survival gardens on one side, poisoned river and choking streets on the other, held together by habit and resignation.

changes.title: River reduced to toxic sludge bed
changes.story: The Ilm runs brown and thin, choked with decades of paint thinner, car wash runoff, and dumped trash.

changes.title: Parking and traffic strangle the streets
changes.story: Half of Weimar still drives short distances; streets are lined with parked cars and exhaust hangs over the squares.

changes.title: Solar panels keep the lights on
changes.story: Rooftops across Weimar carry solar panels; energy saving meant some homes stayed off the grid, but the town's air and water were never fixed.
